response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, exposure to agentic workflows at re:cinq, and deep technical versatility across distributed systems and real-time platforms, but lacks clear evidence of leading AI-native fintech systems at scale, managing teams beyond 10 people, or designing regulated financial AI infrastructure — critical gaps for a CTO role requiring executive leadership and compliance-aware architecture.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven expertise in event-driven systems, microservices, and real-time data handling
Strong open-source contributions and technical communication through workshops and tools
concerns: No demonstrated experience leading engineering teams from 10 to 30+ or building technical leadership layers
Lack of visible fintech infrastructure experience (credit systems, compliance, trade decisioning)
No evidence of designing auditable, model-agnostic AI systems in regulated commercial environments
